title: fr-paperclip runner and a delegate port (Paperclip wakeup, ports and adapters)

labels.name: fr:in-progress
labels.description: An agent is actively working on this

labels.name: fr:claimed
labels.description: Claimed by a triage scope; others keep hands off

body:
Brainstorm in progress on `feat/paperclip-runner` (no PR).

Goal: queue features (GitHub issues) to Paperclip with an fr-supported harness of the operator's choice; a Paperclip triage agent picks them up and runs fr-goal, fr-debugging or another shape; pipeline sub-units (specs, plans, phases, reviews) can be delegated to other agents and harnesses and awaited.

Revised Section 1 (awaiting operator approval):
- **Queue port:** a new `fr-paperclip` run-unit runner driven by triage batches and the drive; phase units via `fr apply --to paperclip` later.
- **Delegate port:** `fr run delegate`, a `delegates.yaml` binding, adapters (`local-subagent`, `paperclip`, later `git-poll`), wakeup via poll; generalise the `reviewer` evidence verifier to any recorded dispatch.
- **Agent kit:** super-fr as a Paperclip skill source; triage, worker and reviewer agent templates.
- **frank:** Paperclip pin bump, agent GitHub token, opencode free models, test companies. Acceptance via persona scenarios on frank's Paperclip.

The session's run cursor was two schema versions old and is being recreated.

Opened during the 2026-10-07 session sweep (super-fr batch adopt, Test Plan item 5) from an ad-hoc session's transcript. Correlated session: herdr tab `w9:t6`.
